description: Update a memory's visibility (private/team) or importance. Use when a user wants to make a memory private, share it with the team, or change its importance. Find the memory ID via search_memories or list_memories first.

importance.description: Change importance score (0-1). Higher = slower decay.

visibility.description: Change who can see this memory. 'private' = only this user. 'team' = all team members.

name: update_memory
title: Update Memory
